overview: Projectile materials should read as a contained energetic body with a bright focal core, controlled edge support, and directional flow that reinforces forward travel without turning into a billboard glow.
common_failure_modes: flat glowing sphere with no focal hierarchy
full-surface emissive flooding instead of a contained core
forcefield shell read instead of projectile body read
neutral benchmark look with no projectile semantics
capture_review_checklist: Front shot keeps a clear bright core or focal center.
Three-quarter shot shows a readable body plus controlled edge support.
Grazing shot strengthens edge shape without overwhelming the core.
The material never collapses into a flat billboard glow.

build_material_shell_core_lane.goal: Establish a readable projectile body with a brighter focal core before edge polish or flow are added.

build_material_fresnel_lane.goal: Add controlled edge support that sharpens the projectile silhouette without replacing the core.

build_material_bump_offset_uv_lane.goal: Introduce directional surface motion after the projectile hierarchy is already readable.
avoid: static body with no travel cue

branch_restart_triggers: flat glowing sphere with no focal hierarchy
full-surface emissive flooding instead of a contained core
neutral benchmark look with no projectile semantics
